previous_statement: Apply lem-maincb-isomorphism-unit-control to B_U oplus B_V, A_R, and v: the preceding threshold gives ||v(I_{B_U oplus B_V})-u_{A_R}||<=C_iso_unit*(delta+epsilon_{A_R})<=C_iso_unit*(M+1)*t<=D_3*t. new_statement: Apply lem-maincb-isomorphism-unit-control to the finite-dimensional C*-algebra B_U oplus B_V, the finite-dimensional extended epsilon_{A_R}-C*-algebra A_R, and the extended delta-isomorphism v from 1.3. The two-sided threshold in 1.4 gives ||v(I_{B_U oplus B_V})-u_{A_R}||<=C_iso_unit*(delta+epsilon_{A_R})<=abs(C_iso_unit)*(K+1)*t<=D_3*t. Together with the extended D_3*t-isomorphism conclusion of 1.3, this is exactly the asserted output.
